name: AE Member Enrollment
description: Daily high-level dashboard of Annual Enrollment progress by Member: Wave-level Set Up/Completed counts, Enrollment Status breakdown, Defaulted (Before/After PSP), multiple-attempts count, and a daily Completed/Abandoned timeline.

feeds.description: ONE consolidated model, all 9 dimensions in this exact order -- RowKind (StatusByWave/DailyTrend/ElectionSummary/WaiverTrend discriminator), EventDate, Wave, Enrollment_Status, Defaulted, Defaulted_Timing, ActivityDate, Membership_Type, Is_Portico_Employee. A single SAC widget can only bind to one Analytic Model total (confirmed on the Employer Election project) -- DS_MEMBER_ENROLLMENT_SUMMARY is now a UNION ALL of 4 row-kinds, each populating only the dimensions/measures relevant to it and leaving the rest NULL. This widget only reads the StatusByWave and DailyTrend row-kinds; ElectionSummary/WaiverTrend are the sibling sac-member-operational-widget's concern, but this is the SAME bound model (same AM_MEMBER_ENROLLMENT_SUMMARY), so all 9 dimensions/22 measures still need to be added here in this exact order. Is_Portico_Employee (added 2026-10-01) is used to EXCLUDE Portico's own employees from this widget's numbers -- see sac-member-enrollment-portico-widget for the mirror widget that shows ONLY them.

ONE consolidated model, all 22 measures in this exact order -- MemberCount, MultipleAttemptsMemberCount, TotalEligibleLives, TotalCoveredLives, WaivedCount, HSA_Count, HSA_Avg_Amount, FSA_Health_Count, FSA_Health_Avg_Amount, FSA_Dependent_Count, FSA_Dependent_Avg_Amount, SuppLife_Member_Count, SuppLife_Member_Avg_Amount, SuppLife_Spouse_Count, SuppLife_Spouse_Avg_Amount, SuppLife_Dependent_Count, SuppLife_Dependent_Avg_Amount, Retirement_Pretax_Count, Retirement_Pretax_Avg_Amount, Retirement_Roth_Count, Retirement_Roth_Avg_Amount, Vision_Election_Count. This widget only reads MemberCount/MultipleAttemptsMemberCount (StatusByWave row-kind) and MemberCount (DailyTrend row-kind).

refresh.description: Re-renders the dashboard from the currently bound data
